turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't ask for pleasantries. I asked why my son has a zero, and who decided it before anyone called me.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
That's very high. The software is quite reliable.
"Quite reliable." Okay. Your own procedure says software results don't establish a concern by themselves, and I have it printed in my bag. So I'll ask again: what else do you have?
So I had to give him a zero.
"Had to." Procedure 4.2 says you call the parent before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out on his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided that?
I hope you understand my position.
"I hope." Okay. Hope isn't a document, Hale, and you still haven't answered who decided to enter that zero before calling me.
